description:
Handmade Turkish Iznik Ceramic Floral Bowl

Bring authentic artisan craftsmanship into your home with this exquisite Turkish Iznik Ceramic Bowl. Renowned worldwide for centuries of pottery excellence, traditional Iznik art features vibrant glazes and intricate hand-painted motifs. This piece showcases a stunning blue tulip and botanical pattern adorned with classic textured, raised-relief detailing, making it both a functional catchall and a striking decorative centerpiece.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Origin: Authentic Turkish handmade and hand-painted pottery
  • Design Motif: Traditional Iznik floral and tulip design
  • Texture: Raised-relief painting gives the surface tactile depth and texture
  • Color Palette: Rich cobalt blue, light blue, and white accented with traditional glazes
  • Versatility: Perfect as a display piece, entryway bowl, trinket dish, or vibrant table centerpiece

Condition

Item Condition: Excellent condition. Please examine all high-resolution photos carefully to appreciate the artisan detail and verify physical condition. Because this item is handcrafted, subtle variations in paint and glaze are natural characteristics that add to its unique charm.

Shipping & Handling

Ceramics are delicate, and we take packaging seriously. This bowl will be securely wrapped in bubble wrap, cushioned with protective packing material, and dispatched in a sturdy box to ensure safe arrival. Fast dispatch with tracking provided upon shipment.

Customer Satisfaction

Your satisfaction is our top priority. If you have questions about dimensions, care, or details prior to purchase, please reach out via eBay messaging for a prompt response.
